definitions.gloss: mandatory vehicle inspection; periodic car inspection
definitions.explanation: The legally required periodic safety inspection that all registered vehicles in Japan must undergo. New cars must pass their first inspection after three years, then every two years thereafter.

examples.japanese: {車検|しゃけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{車検|しゃけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}さ→通す：02300_toosu⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: I have to get my car inspected next month.

examples.japanese: {車検|しゃけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}くて→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised that the vehicle inspection cost more than I expected.

notes: Short for {自動車検査登録制度|じどうしゃけんさとうろくせいど}. In Japan, {車検|しゃけん} is mandatory and quite expensive, often costing over 100,000 yen including taxes and fees. Common collocations: {車検|しゃけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧ (to pass inspection), {車検|しゃけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧ (inspection expires), {車検|しゃけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to take in for inspection), {車検|しゃけん}⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧ (inspection cost). Driving with an expired {車検|しゃけん} is illegal.
